scene.bubble: New timetable, team! Maths before break, science after lunch… and double sport on Friday!

activities.title: Match the subject with what you do in it.
Read Ingrid's timetable and choose the right answer.

data.instructions: Read the text. Choose the correct answer.
data.text: Monday is my favourite day. We start with music at half past eight — I sit next to Oliver, and he is brilliant at the guitar. Then we have maths for two hours. After break we do science with Mr Holm; last week we made a small volcano! We have lunch at one o'clock, and in the afternoon there is art. I always paint mountains. We finish at half past three.

activities.title: Listen. Diego interviews Ingrid about Tuesday. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Diego: Radio Aurora! Ingrid, what's your Tuesday like? … Ingrid: We start with geography. We're studying rivers of South America. … Diego: Interesting! And after that? … Ingrid: History. We're learning about castles this month. … Diego: What do you do at break? … Ingrid: We play basketball in the playground. … Diego: And what's your last lesson? … Ingrid: Sport — my favourite! We're practising for the swimming competition. … Diego: Do you have much homework? … Ingrid: Only maths. Twenty exercises! … Diego: Twenty! Good luck, captain!
